reply_text:
I told Hollis in #central-team that it's 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in the channel on Oct 14 as the seat count for the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal, and nothing posted there since changes it.

I only checked #central-team, after confirming Hollis is a member. gbrain didn't return anything: it refused the search because its connection isn't tied to a member. Whoever runs the gbrain server can fix that with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. A seat count is an operational fact, so it was fine to share with the Central team.
